expression.original: Independent audit of the circle-six-gap-proof artifact (zip sha256 fc5eee631010907c0e7fab81481e36bfb668aa93080bfc026009d1b0954d3c87): the artifact's own verify.sh contract passed on a freshly installed Lean 4.22.0 toolchain (EXIT=0; 129 declarations, all axiom-free by #print axioms; no source drift; checksums intact), and every central numerical claim was re-derived from standard textbook definitions in an audit script written without reference to the artifact's code, using two structurally different methods (brute-force bar-complex enumeration and Smith-normal-form matrix ranks) that agree with each other and with the artifact: the four-row mu4 H3 table, |Z3|=32/64, |B3|=16/32, the mu8 pinch witnesses at (n,k)=(8,3), the pentagon-untwisted-cocycle correspondence over all 65536 symbol assignments, the hexagon/braiding sector (boson +-1, fermion +-i), and the |H3| = gcd(1+k,n)*gcd(k-1,n)/n formula extended beyond the artifact's own range to n=16. Two defects found, both non-fatal: the artifact's regex-based axiom audit does not cover 'inductive' declarations (one benign inductive U escapes the net), and a stale header claims 41 theorems where 49 exist.
expression.elaboration: The audit deliberately re-derived rather than re-ran: agreement between two runs of the same code is one perspective counted twice; agreement between independently constructed projections of the same object is what narrows the ambiguity set. Full report, re-derivation script, and verify.sh transcript are in audits/circle-six-gap-proof/ in this repository.
